As the title states, submissions containing pre-teen subjects are no longer allowed on this subverse. We will begin deleting such submissions as we see them, and ask that you exercise your own discretion and delete your submissions that may violate this new ruling.

Additionally, we're discussing what to do concerning teen models. There are many models that are exploited, coerced, and abused. And we don't wish to be a part of that on this sub.

Lastly, in addition to the common sense of not posting anything with nudity in it, refrain from posting anything lascivious.

Please let us know either in a comment below or in a private message how you feel about the current state of /v/youngteens, and where you see the sub heading in the future. Any feedback is welcome. Thanks for your time.

Firewall.. In my modem? I wish to know more about this

Sure :)

Most people have a modem that lets many computers connect using the one internet connection. However, the Internet was originally designed to assume only one computer per connection, so the modem is given a unique number on the Internet and then shares that to all the computers using a thing called "NAT" (Network Address Translation)

As a result, the modem (or technically the router the modem is attached to) waits for one of the computers to ask for something on the Internet, and then has to remember which computer it was that asked so the reply can go to the right computer.

But it doesn't automatically work the other way... if a computer on the Internet wants to talk to one of yours without yours asking for it, the modem (router) won't know which computer to send it to so normally it ignores it. (Which is basically what a firewall does - block unwanted stuff.)

So yeah, unless you're using dialup, or some funky direct cable connection with one computer or a satellite dish; odds are you're using NAT and thus have a firewall by default :)

(Plus the one built into Windows which is on by default since XP SP2 I think.)
